prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1380; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and has asked us to handle all matters arising from it. Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a copy of the declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may apply, including excess or umbrella policies.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, recorded statements, dashcam or telematics data, vehicle inspection and repair records, the claim file, adjuster notes, and any police or incident reports in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal of these materials while the claim remains open.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and the steps your company will take.
